page: Amazon Web Services r7iz.32xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 128 vCPUs and 64 physical cores from an Intel Xeon 6455B processor running at a dedicated clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance across multiple categories. The multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth, both cached and uncached, rank in the top 10% of tested systems. The server excels in database operations, achieving top-tier results in Passmark database tests and processing 149.32 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks. Additionally, the hardware supports advanced vector and matrix extensions, including AVX-512 and AMX, which contribute to top-tier performance in LLM inference for medium-sized models and software compilation.

Given its high-density DDR5 memory and high-frequency Intel Xeon processor, this instance offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads without requiring GPU acceleration. The absence of local storage means storage costs are decoupled, allowing for flexible network-attached storage configurations. The r7iz.32xlarge is highly suited for in-memory databases, large-scale Redis deployments, high-throughput web serving, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
